name: Ocean Sciences Ltd
summary: Ocean Sciences Ltd and its associated entities procure, produce, promote and sell traditional medicinal items in Australia, Singapore, China and Southeast Asia. Its range includes raw and processed bird's nest and marine botanicals such as sea grapes and seaweeds, used in food, nutrition, healthcare, supplements, cosmetics and personal care. Founded in 1984 and based in Melbourne, it adopted its current name in June 2023.
